title: Verify daftar upah Excel export includes total_tunjangan in upah_kotor
description: Check if daftarUpahExcelService.ts properly includes total_tunjangan in the upah_kotor calculation. The formula should be: upah_kotor = gp_aktual + total_tunjangan + total_premi + pendapatan_lainnya - pot_koreksi. Need to verify the Excel export formula matches the PayrollCalculator.

files.change: Line 544-548: Verify formula `${lGA}${r}+${lTunj}${r}+${lTotalPremi}${r}${otherIncomeFormula}${koreksiFormula}` correctly uses gp_aktual + total_tunjangan. Line 349: Verify UPAH KOTOR header says '(GP+Tunj+Premi)'.

criteria: Daftar Upah Excel export formula includes total_tunjangan column in upah_kotor calculation
